programme.title: 驅魔黑修女
programme.desc: Are you ready to venture into the forbidden? Sister Giunia is convinced that the evil spirit possessing Hee-joon is one of the 12 Manifestations. With the exorcist priest unable to come in time and Hee-joon's life clearly at risk, Sister Giunia decides to break a sacred rule: ‘An unordained nun cannot perform an exorcism.' However, Father Paolo, Hee-joon's attending physician, firmly believes that only medicine can save the boy. When Sister Giunia discovers a secret about Father Paolo's disciple, Sister Michela, she recklessly seeks her help to smuggle Hee-joon out of the hospital. Despite clashing with the fearless Giunia, Michela, feeling a connection to the boy, decides to join forces. Together, the two nuns embark on a dangerous ritual, determined to save the boy at all costs, no matter the risks or consequences. There's only one rule: Save him at all cost.(n)

programme.title: 刺心切骨
programme.desc: Young fencer Zijie finds his world upended when his older brother, three-time national fencing champion Zihan, is released from juvenile prison. Zihan was incarcerated for what he maintains was the accidental death of an opponent. Zijie wants some connection (and fencing tips) from his enigmatic older brother, but their mother is convinced of Zihan's malevolence and seeks to end their brotherly bond. Featuring meticulously staged fencing matches and pitch-perfect performances, this unnerving psychodrama announces Nelicia Low as a future talent to follow.(n)

programme.title: 三更
programme.desc: THREE brings together three tales of life beyond physical death. Each of them exploring the beliefs, superstitions and mysteries of a different Asian culture.(n)

credits.director: 陳可辛, 金知雲, 朗斯尼美畢達

programme.title: 激戰
programme.desc: After a stint in prison for participating in underground boxing, Fai is knee-deep in debt with no solution in sight. To escape his debtors, he flees to Macau and works as a gym assistant. He meets and ends up training Si-Qi, a hot-blooded young man who enrolled in an open MMA competition with no fighting experience. After a series of wins, Si-Qi is critically injured and eliminated from the tournament. Ignited by Si-Qi's persistence and unwillingness to give up in the face of defeat, he rediscovers his will to fight and steps back in the ring against the fighter who injured his student..(n)

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -拍戲4拍4
programme.desc: It took Band Four 8 years from sketch to a movie. Kay Tse and Teddy Robin, who played distant daughter and father in the movie, thought the characters were quite different from them in person, as they found themselves on beat in reality. Speaking of director Mo Lai Yan Chi, they each have a story with her to tell..(n)

programme.title: 4拍4家族
programme.desc: “Band Four” is the story of Cat aspiring to make her mark on the global music stage, while contending with the haunting absence of her father, King, a guitarist who abandoned her and her mother two decades ago. Cat's life takes a dramatic turn when her mother succumbs to illness, and King unexpectedly appears at the funeral together with Matilda, Cat's previously unknown adolescent stepsister, further complicating Cat's ongoing struggle to raise her own 9-year-old son, Riley. Forced to live together in a crowded Hong Kong flat, the newly reunited family finds itself in a vortex of conflicting personalities, insecurities, and priorities. The family finds amidst this turmoil a common communication channel via music. Just as the familial bond begins to form through their shared musical language, both their bond and Band Four's survival are put to the test by a fresh set of unforeseen challenges.(n)

programme.title: 緊急迫降
programme.desc: Veteran chief police detective In-ho (SONG Kang-ho) receives a tip about a man threatening a terrorist attack against a plane. While investigating, he discovers that the suspect has actually boarded flight no. KI501. Despite his phobia of flying, Jae-hyuk (LEE Byung-hun) decides to go to Hawaii for the sake for his daughter's health. At the airport, he is distracted by a strange man who hangs around, speaking to them in a menacing way. Flight no. KI501 departs Incheon Airport for Hawaii, but soon afterwards a man dies for mysterious reasons. Fear and chaos spread quickly, not only inside the plane, but also on land. Hearing this news, Transport Minister Sook-hee (JEON Do-yeon) sets up a counterterrorism task force and calls an emergency meeting in order to find a way to land the airplane.(n)

programme.title: 冤鴦大盜
programme.desc: Dojo and May are a loving couple. Because Dojo has a brain tumor and needs 1 million baht for the operation, they decide to rob a money exchange store. Unluckily, the couple with 10 unfortunate patrons of the money exchange center are held hostages by 3 professional robbers on the same day. It is a robbery inside another robbery as well as some secrets among these people will be revealed. What could possibly happen when these people are trapped in the store with no way to escape.(n)

programme.title: 老鼠愛上貓
programme.desc: Based on the popular Chinese novel Qi Xia Wu Yi about the story of Judge Pao in the Song Dynasty and his group of heroic helpers, who together solve cases and catch criminals galore. In the original story, Zhan Zhao is constantly at loggerheads with Bai Yutong, a Robin Hood figure who assists Judge Pao from the other side of the law. Their conflict experiences a modern rendition in this hilariously iconoclastic film.(n)

programme.title: 12.12：首爾之春
programme.desc: After the assassination of President Park, martial law has been declared. A coup d'etat bursts out by Defense Security Commander CHUN Doo-gwang and a private band of officers following him. Capital Defense Commander LEE Tae-shin, an obstinate soldier who believes the military should not take political actions, fights against CHUN Doo-gwang to stop him. The conflict between the two grows while military leaders are holding their decision and Defense Minister is gone. In the midst of chaos, the spring of Seoul that everyone longed for heads to unexpected direction.(n)

programme.title: 熱帶往事
programme.desc: On a dark night, Xueming hits a pedestrian with his car and flees the scene. Desperate to escape his feelings of guilt, he decides to approach the dead man's wife, Mrs Liang. Meanwhile, the body is discovered - riddled with bullets. Chen, the detective in charge of the investigation, becomes obsessed with the case. Years later, all three remain caught in a tangled web of memories and lies, desperately searching for a truth that refuses to be revealed..(n)

programme.title: 這個阿爸真爆炸
programme.desc: Ying is a single parent who's having a tough time disciplining his wild teenage daughter Ellen. When Ying is mistaken to be the famous gangster hero 'Shadowless Eagle', he gains both recognition and popularity among Ellen's gangster classmates, and she begins to gain new respect for her father. But Ying's legend becomes more than he can handle when some real triad members come seeking revenge.(n)

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.(n)

programme.title: 分手的決心
programme.desc: Kind and polite detective Haejun is entrusted with a case of unnatural death in the mountains. While investigating the case, he meets Seorae, the dead victim's wife, and can't help but both suspect and develop an interest in her.(n)

programme.title: 廉政風雲 煙幕
programme.desc: The multi-year ICAC investigation into the Lida Conglomerate is on the brink of collapse after the CEO's disappearance and the whistleblower's fleeing to Australia. To salvage the case, a top ICAC agent teams with a fellow investigator (who happens to be his estranged wife) and risks their lives to bring the witness back to Hong Kong.(n)

programme.title: 靈慾咒怨
programme.desc: Online fashion model Hyo-jung faces the imminent threat of being unemployed because of the younger and more fashionable generation coming after her. While relying on surgical procedures and treatments, Hyo-jung hears about a mysterious yoga class that helps make perfect body shape from her old high school classmate, Ga-young. Hyo-jung eventually attends the yoga class with three classmates: Mi-yeon, a boxer who failed to keep her body fit, Ji-won, who has an unstable mental condition, and Ye-na, a movie start who is morbidly obsessed with her appearance. Meanwhile, police start to investigate the enigma behind this yoga class after finding out that a murder in the neighbourhood was committed by a woman named Bo-ram a former student of the yoga class..(n)

programme.title: 樣衰衰奇兵
programme.desc: From the filmmakers of Shrek and Alita: Battle Angel comes a new animated musical adventure. In the adorably different town of Uglyville, the free-spirited Moxy and her UglyDolls friends confront what it means to be different, struggle with their desire to be loved, and ultimately discover that you don't have to be perfect to be amazing because who you truly are is what matters most.(n)

programme.title: 竊聽風雲2
programme.desc: LAW Man-seng is one of the most reputable securities dealers in Hong Kong. One day, he drives his luxury sports car and notices that a car is tailing him. His car finally crashes and Law is sent to the hospital. At the hospital, he sees a police officer HO Chi-keung, and thinks the officer is here for the car accident. But Ho works for the Department of Homeland Security which is responsible for counter-terrorism. Ho has found some surveillance devices in the wreckage of Law's sports car which are for military use..(n)

programme.title: 困獸
programme.desc: The President of Gaming Association blacklisted Wa Sam Group from bidding of gaming concessions on the ground. This blacklisting triggered a series of retaliations from Wa Sam Group. Thus, the Anti-Triad Office immediately set up a special team lead by Lee Shui Ming and he called back Man Fung for help. Fourth Elder's wife Chu Lei received a phone call from her ex-boyfriend Man Fung for a meeting. Kwan Chit, a member of the Gaming Association with the support of Wa Sam Group, also persuaded Man Fung to stop keeping his eyes on them. The two have parted in discord. Kwan Chit remembered the tragic death of his ex-girlfriend Man Kei, sister of Man Fung. He came to Man Fung late at night, the two old friends finally agreed to revenge for their beloved one together.(n)

programme.title: 極速快遞
programme.desc: “I deliver everything that the post office service does not handle.” Eun-ha, who is a normal junkyard employee, secretly works as a delivery clerk that deals with unusual delivery request. One day, Eun-ha heads to Seoul to pick up a client who is involved in a gambling crime that wants to flee overseas. However, Eun-ha meets the client's young son at the pick-up point, instead of the client himself. Kyung-pil, a current police officer who is actually masterminding the whole gambling crime, chases after the missing child who has the security key to the bank account that holds 30 million dollars. After a long pursuit from Seoul to Busan, Eun-ha fights against the police to protect the child.(n)

programme.title: 中國合伙人
programme.desc: 80's. 3 undergraduates share a common ambition - to live the American dream. They establish a tutorial school New Vision, yet the sudden fame are tearing their friendship apart..(n)

programme.title: 愛在安娜普納峰
programme.desc: On a sunny spring day, Kang Hyun goes hiking in Bugaksan Mountain with Sun Woo who has been recently discharged from the military. It is already past noon but they continue a casual conversation about their past relationships while hiking along trails. Kang Hyun reminisces about the bittersweet memories of his exes ‘Anna' and ‘Eun Chae', while Sun Woo regrets treating his ex ‘Eun Jung' badly and blames his immaturity in the past relationship with ‘Pureum'.Kang Hyun and Sun Woo come across different people along the trail. They pass by a good-looking woman in tight leggings who instantly capture their eyes. They also come across a middle-aged man who gives disappointing hiking tips, which make them feel hopeless. ‘Anna' and ‘Pureum' incarnate our bygone lovers who we once strongly admired but failed to reach.Though hiking is as tough as life can be, it can also bring you joy because some people come into our lives and make us happy. Though Annapurna is one of the toughest moun.(n)

programme.title: 我愛HK開心萬歲
programme.desc: Ng Shun returns with his wife Shun-Soh and three children to celebrate Ng Kin's 60th birthday. Unknown to Kin, his son has gotten into trouble and is plotting for him to take the rap. At the same time, Long, a swindler who conned money from the neighbours 30 years ago is now a property tycoon. He promises to pay each of the 30 neighbours HK$100 million as compensation as long as a representative of each household returns to the estate on Lunar New Year's Eve. A mad rush ensues as Shun and his family tries to gather the old neighbours to avoiding missing the bonanza.(n)

programme.title: 深夜咖啡屋：消失了愛人
programme.desc: Bride-to-be Yoon waits for her groom Tae-young on their wedding day but he doesn't show up. Out of concern and anger, she searches for him all day and in the dead of night, she arrives at a strange place called 'Cafe Midnight', which opens from midnight until the sun rises. Upon entering Yoon finally finds Tae-young, but something doesn't seem right. He looks a few years younger and he doesn't even recognize her. As past, present and future merge, will the bride find her groom.(n)

programme.title: 假面之夜
programme.desc: An anonymous letter is delivered to the police – a warning that the killer involved in a mysterious homicide that occurred a few days ago in a condominium in Tokyo will strike again at “Masquerade Night”, the New Year's Eve countdown party held at Hotel Cortesia, Tokyo. All 500 invitees will be in costume. Everyone is a suspect. As the masked guests begin to arrive, they struggle to find a clue which will lead them to the murderer. Midnight draws near as the number of suspects increases. What is the killer's intention? Who is the informant? Will Nitta and Yamagishi be able to unveil the truth hidden behind the murderer's mask before the time limit.(n)

programme.title: 大上海
programme.desc: It was 1917, China. CHENG was an innocent young man who worked in a grocery store and had no ambition, other than to be with his lovely neighbour, the Peking Opera student QIU. But a fateful night had changed Cheng's life forever, as he literally walked right in the affair between his lady boss and the chief of police. To hide this secret, the chief decided to throw Cheng into prison, accusing him of raping his lady boss. Desolated, Cheng met a cellmate MAO, who happened to have an escape plan. The duo broke out, and Cheng had no choice but to leave his life, and his dream girl behind..(n)

programme.title: 飯戲攻心
programme.desc: It is often said that food and meals bring families together, but in TABLE FOR SIX it's clear that not all family gatherings are a cause for celebration. In this melodramatic comedy, three brothers reside in a home that they inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother Steve (Dayo Wong), theoretically is the man of the house, but he constantly is getting dissed by his two younger brothers Bernard (Louis Cheung Kai Chung) and Lung (Chan Charm Man Peter) for the decisions he makes, the inedible meals that he cooks, and his complicated romantic encounters. To prepare for a family reunion dinner, Steve seeks the help of Lung's girlfriend and foodie Josephine (Ivana Wong) and in doing so, wins back their hearts for a while, until his old flame and Bernard's new girlfriend Monica (Stephy Tang) shows up. That's a recipe for a disaster waiting to explode! The unexpected visit of Steve's part-time girlfriend Meow (Lin Min-Chen) not only fails to turn down the heat and cool th.(n)

programme.title: 新最佳拍檔
programme.desc: White Glove steals terra-cotta warriors and Brother and Sister disguise themselves as the 'ACES' partners King Kong and Kodajak steal the Sword of Chin Dynasty from White Glove swears to revenge on the 'ACES' partners. The real and new 'ACES' partners will join together with police to fight against White Glove.(n)

programme.title: 道道道
programme.desc: One stormy night, a wise High Priest and his student, Fong, pass by the Orchid Temple and realize it is haunted. Here, Fong encounters two lady demons, the seductive Lotus and her hated sister, Butterfly. Although Fong knows his Master wants to capture these evil spirits, he finds himself attracted to the Ghost and allows them to go free. The monks stay at the Temple is prolonged due to Fong carelessly misplacing their valuable Taolisman, the Gold Suddna. During a trip to the corrupt local town, the High Priest meets Yin by chance and a series of misunderstandings evolve..(n)

programme.title: 無敵幸運星
programme.desc: A Dying man is leaving behind him a no good son, a very good daughter, a scheming nephew, a vast fortune and a will which bequeaths everything to the daughter. So the scheming nephew gets Tricky star to steal the will in order to alter it. The son is not idle either. He finds Phoenix, a garbage collector, to pose as the absent daughter who looks the same as Phoenix. Phoenix files into Hong Kong and gets into the house in great pomp. She also surprises a thieving Tricky Star, who immediately assumes the role of a suitor. That pleases Phoenix immensely..(n)

programme.title: 天下無敵
programme.desc: “The Invincible fighter” is a documentary covering Jackie Chan's rise in the Hong Kong film industry. Included are some of Jackie Chan's greatest moves and stunts, from ten of his classic Hong Kong films including Cub Tiger from Kwantung, Shaolin Wooden Men, Spiritual Kung Fu, and many more. And also includes footage of various Kung Fu styles.(n)

programme.title: 三人新世界
programme.desc: Advertising professional Alex, has been living with Chu Lai Ngo and her daughter Vivian, in harmony. Alex has to go to Paris with director Joe, for ad production. Due to the suspicion of Alex's fidelity, Chu and Vivian follow Alex to Paris and cause dramatic argument with Joe. Because Chu feels her relationship with Alex is in danger, she threatens Alex to marry her once they return to Hong Kong. Otherwise, she will marry Alex's cousin and go to Canada..(n)

programme.title: 精武小英雄
programme.desc: After being ousted from his post, the insane, General Yuan Si Kai took out his anger by ordering his men to track down and kill five orphans. General Chai helped fight to protect the orphans from the murderous wrath of Yuan. During protecting the five orphans to a safe place, they were attacked and the five orphans almost were killed..(n)

programme.title: 七年之癢
programme.desc: Living together for 7 years, Raymond has been faithful to Sylvia. But he is eager to having an affair after being teased by his colleagues. On his business trip to Singapore, he is being used by a charming girl, Siu Hung to smuggle some stolen jewelry. Raymond mistakes for love luck yet he fails to have an affair with Siu Hung before she sneaks away with the jewelry. When he returns home, a diamond ring is found in his luggage and Sylvia takes it as her birthday present. Raymond is so involved with Siu Hung that he decides to take Sylvia on a trip to Singapore to bring back the memory. He requests Sylvia to act if they were first met, but it comes an intruder Money who falls in love with Sylvia at first sight..(n)

programme.title: 聽不到的說話
programme.desc: Ah Heung, who was dumb, was the leader of a gang of deaf and dumb pickpockets - Giraffe, Tortoise, Dragon and the recently released Panther who had been confined in prison for six months on behalf of Ah Heung. When Ah Heung and her gangsters were celebrating the release of Panther in a fast food restaurant, they ran into Kee who had also just finished his terms in prison for eight years. However, they found themselves being ambushed by a gang of teddy-boys headed by Robert who were used to be opponent of Ah Heung. It was Kee who fought independently against Robert's gang and saved Ah Heung from danger. After that, their heart-broken story begins..(n)

programme.title: 刺客新傳之殺人者唐斬
programme.desc: A country bumpkin and flower lover, Tong Po, falls in love with a girl, he is not allowed to marry. They try to run away together, but they are captured and he is thrown into a jail where his eyes are sewn shut. Next, his eyes are opened to find himself and some fellow prisoners in a gladiatorial ring where they must kill each other in order to survive, the last man standing gets to live and be trained as an executioner for a power corrupted eunuch. Tong Po wins of course, becomes an adept killing machine, is renamed Tong Chop, and given an apprentice who both idolizes and wants to replace him. During one nighttime raid, Tong sees the girl and his past starts creeping back on him, so he leaves the killing business and hides out with her in her village where she has remarried and has a son..(n)

programme.title: 蠍子戰士
programme.desc: Fei comes to Hong Kong with his son Yushu and winds up a back-alley barber. Yushu is now in high school but he only likes to draw pictures. He also is hot blooded, thus often getting into fights. By accident, Yushu meets beautiful Ru. He learns that Inspector Hua and underworld boss Wang are working together in prostitution and human traffic. Yushu helps Ru to escape from Wang 's catches. Fei, Yushu and Ru are being haunted by Hua's men, but are saved by self-styled kungfu master Jean-Paul. They are taken in by Master Yi and asks Yushu to prepare the beef noodles but he only wants to learn kungfu from Jean-Paul. However, Yushu realizes Master Yi actually is the kungfu master. He begs Master Yi to teach him the skills and fight against evil forces together..(n)

programme.title: 怒火威龍
programme.desc: In Hong Kong a retired Godfather's daughter Lisa, hired Professor Lau to assist in the search for the Crystal. Lau together with his assistant Peter to make preparation for the Crystal hunt in the forbidden land. Unfortunately, their mission was accidentally discovered by the gang leader Steven and Eddie. Steven killed Peter and Kidnapped Lau to hunt for the Crystal Madam Wu was the head of a special police squad team, her colleague were killed by a gang. Wu vowed to find the gang leader and prosecute him..(n)

programme.title: 新半斤八兩
programme.desc: Michael Hui's comic screenplay gives us his visionary portrayal of the 'paparazzi' during the early 1990s when tabloid pres changed the face of mainstream media.(n)

programme.title: 午夜麗人
programme.desc: Blackie and Ling are working in a reputable business firm. Blackie who was a night club hostess and is now living with her boyfriend. Ling does not like office work. So she takes on a part time job as ballroom hostess but keeps it a secret. Blackie's boyfriend reneges on his promise to marry her, giving her past as his pretext. And soon the office gets word the two girls have been midnight girls. They both have to resign and become night club hostesses. They are keen to make big money so they try to get racing tips from a young jockey..(n)

programme.title: 走進老許記
programme.desc: Look back on 4 comedy classics with 7 top filmmakers of our time. Explore the cultural impact of The Hui Brothers – the most successful cinema trio in Hong Kong history.(n)

programme.title: 鬼馬雙星
programme.desc: Teng is the No. 1 con man plus professional gambler in jail. During the jail time, he meets young Liu and the two become friends. Once they get out of jail they team up to make fortune. The two gamblers try their hands at several profitable projects. One day, Liu hits upon a grand plan, but it needs a lot of capital. Therefore he decides to participate in a TV contest so as to win the money..(n)

programme.title: 水滸傳之英雄本色
programme.desc: The story between Lin Chun, the 'leopard' and Lu Chi-sum, the 'sharp-witted monk' is one of the most brilliantly portrayed episode in the Chinese novel 'All men are brothers'. The story tells of Lin Chun, Chief Instructor of eight hundred thousand Imperial Guards, is naive to the intricacy of power politics. His honesty and loyalty leads him to be framed by the treacherous court officials..(n)

programme.title: 警察故事III
programme.desc: Detective Chan is recruited by Interpol to infiltrate the operations of a drug lord. He is forced to survive with his wits and courage during the most dangerous mission.(n)

programme.title: 妖魔道
programme.desc: Cher Kei was waiting for 500 years for the reason she hope an evil girl would growth. Her thought was combining the evil power of Choi Yi and her together. Thus she can govern the world of human being. But the master Bai Mei wanted to destroy the project of cher kei. Thus, Bai Mei took away Choi Yi , and made her to be a follower. When Choi Yi was eighteen. Bai Mei made Choi Yi get married with Liu Chun because she wanted to clear the evil property of Choi Yi..(n)

programme.title: 八喜臨門
programme.desc: The Ng family: Doctor Ng, Mrs. Ng, Ng Chee, Ng Lei and Ng Choi went to picnic happily. Hereon, different romances happened between them: First of all, Lei was attracted by Macdonna, a very sexy girl; Chee love little Rambo who saved her from two 'teddy' boys; Choi loved her elder cousin who was graduated from a foreign university and had not found a job yet; Ms Ng decided to apply for the post of actress for a drama association. Billy, the director of the drama was the divorced father of little Rambo. He fell in love with Mrs.Ng at the first sight..(n)

programme.title: 音樂殭屍
programme.desc: A crazy white scientist resurrects a corpse with a weird chemical creating a super hopping ghost. The only thing that can somewhat control it is the sound of music. A Tao Priest and his two assistants try and stop it from destroying the countryside..(n)

programme.title: 豪門夜宴
programme.desc: “The Banquet” assembled star-studded cast that aimed for charity to support disaster relief efforts at that time. Adapted from the 1959 Cantonese film of the same name and co-directed by Tsui Hark, Clifton Ko, Joe Cheung, and Alfred Cheung, the film tells the story of a greedy couple deceiving their estranged father to secure a huge amount business deal with oil producing country. While they pretend to welcome the father into their home and prepare a birthday banquet for him, rival also throws a competing banquet...With continuous top-star cameos offering countless surprises and laughs, this film remains remarkable, entertaining and meaningful to audience nowadays.(n)

credits.director: 徐克, 高志森, 張同祖, 張堅庭

programme.title: 鐵板燒
programme.desc: Mr. Wong is the chief chef in the Teppanyaki Restaurant of his father-in-law. One day, he meets his dream girl, Sissy. He starts chasing her and arranges for a tour to Paradise Island with her. Unfortunately, his wife and her friend went with her..(n)

programme.title: 唐山大兄
programme.desc: Cheng was a Chinese man who moves to Thailand to live with his cousins and works in an ice factory. When a block of ice is accidentally broken, a bag of white powder falls out..(n)

programme.title: 精武門
programme.desc: Chen Zhen returns to Jingwu School to marry his fiancee. But tragic news awaits him: his master Huo Yuanjia has died, apparently from illness. He's deeply saddened and traumatised..(n)

programme.title: 猛龍過江
programme.desc: Chen's restaurant is being targeted by the local mafia. Tang fends off the gangsters and wins her admiration. The mafia boss sends a gunman to kill Tang, but Tang defeats him..(n)

programme.title: 死亡遊戲
programme.desc: When Billy refuses to be intimidated by henchman Steiner, Dr. Land orders his assassination to serve as an example to others. Stick sneaks onto the set of Billy's new film...(n)

programme.title: 警察故事III
programme.desc: Detective Chan is recruited by Interpol to infiltrate the operations of a drug lord. He is forced to survive with his wits and courage during the most dangerous mission.(n)

programme.title: 整蠱王
programme.desc: Happy specializes in playing tricks, but he refuses to work for rich man Shi. By coincidence, Happy meets Moon and falls for her. However, he is not aware it is just a trick..(n)

programme.title: 警網雄風
programme.desc: Ko Ching Fai is the cop spy, for concealing the status of the Triad Society to merge into the organization, but his father blame on him as he does not know the truth. His father is killed later since he knows something about Ching Lap Shan. When Fai goes to the funeral for sacrificing his father with his sister Ko Chi Ling, they have an argument. In order to consider of the situation for his girlfriend Lisa and his sister, he decides to leave the organization, however it is rejected by his supervisor. Fai affiliates an opportunity to make friend with Yuen, they are trap when they have a bargain with other gang..(n)

programme.title: 靈氣迫人
programme.desc: Angie was an undergraduate from Canada who was in holiday in Hong Kong as well as doing research work for her thesis - 'Chinese Superstition'. She looked for accommodation and met Hansom. While Angie disguised herself as a ghost to scare Hansom, he was thrown out of the window by a genuine ghost. Detective Valentino came to investigate the accident and they unfolded the actual happening of the tragic evening when Singer Lisa Law had shot her lover..(n)

programme.title: 影人映語 -中產喜劇大師—陳慶嘉
programme.desc: Since the 1980's, Chan Hing Kai has created numerous love comedies, yet he opened up that he was “forced” to write them at that time. Later on, he wrote and co-directed “La Brassiere”, a film which entertains without being obscene. He reveals that one of the leading actor, Lau Ching Wan, complained to him afterwards... In this episode, Hing Kai is invited to share the untold stories from his writing career and talk about the changing ecology of screenwriting in the film industry.(n)

programme.title: 鎗王
programme.desc: The key witness of a famous trial and 6 cops are assassinated. Miu knows Rick is back. Years ago in a shooting contest, Rick and Miu knew they were borne to be the sworn enemies.(n)

programme.title: 奇門遁甲
programme.desc: Two elderly Taoist priests, Chi Men and Dun Jia, who learn their magic from the same teacher always quarrel with each other. They provide mirth and expert kung fu tuition to young man who is mistakenly presumed to be the crown prince of the Imperial Court, missing since childhood. The emperor dispatches an eunuch with the magic powers to apprehend the young man. But he must first deal with Chi Men and Dun Jia who are the young man's protector..(n)

programme.title: 我家有一隻河東獅
programme.desc: During Soong dynasty, there lived a beauty named Moth Liu. She has gone to blind dates for many times. Still she cannot get married, until she meets a talented poet Seasonal Chan. Seasonal is making his debut as Soo's special guest in a reading-concert, his avant-garde style is badly received, only Moth supports him whole heatedly. Not long afterwards the two get married, and only until then Seasonal realizes that he has married to a roaring lion who limits him on all his activities and expenses..(n)

programme.title: 安娜瑪德蓮娜
programme.desc: A romantic tale about 3 young people who starts out as adversaries and blossoms into something else. When a gorgeous female moves into the building and 2 men fall in love with her.(n)

programme.title: 黑雪
programme.desc: Maggie returns to Hong Kong to bring her grandmother back for settlement in Canada. Only her fiance Michael comes to welcome her back, but Jacky and Carol, her good friends and married couple, fail to appear. Jacky Chan, a cartoonist, is in fact a long-time cocaine doper and is therefore deeply in debts. Sam, one of the hired thugs of the drug-dealer constantly comes to collect debts. It greatly irritates Carol. Michael goes so far as to collaborate with the drug dealer for benefits. Moreover, he supplies cocaine to Jacky once in a while. Jacky is under the delusion that cocaine inhalation will help him gain inspiration in cartoon-drawing, but contrarily, cocaine only makes him get into real trouble. He resorts to satisfy his urge for drugs by snatching his wife's money and accidentally hurts her. Carol ultimately tells the whole story in tears to Maggie..(n)

programme.title: 六指琴魔
programme.desc: In ancient China, a group of martial arts masters' team up to steal a magical Lyre, that corrupts the souls of those who possess it. The Lyre is also coveted because of its supernatural powers well versed musician can release the power of the Lyre in a great destructive force. The allied masters and their soldiers Pearl Harbor the home of the man who guards the Lyre. The evil masters attack the man's family, resulting in the death of everyone except for his son, Lui Lun, and his older sister, Snow, who escapes with the Lyre. Years later, Snow (Brigitte Lin) is a lethal practitioner of the martial arts, who has mastered the powers of the Lyre. She puts into effect her plan to strike back at those martial arts masters who destroyed her family. Lui Lun (Yuen Biao) is also fully grown, and well-versed in Kung Fu, but he has no idea that his parents were murdered, as he was adopted by a wise man who owns an escort agency. Snow entangles her brother in her plot to gain revenge when.(n)

programme.title: 影人映語 -中產喜劇大師—陳慶嘉
programme.desc: Since the 1980's, Chan Hing Kai has created numerous love comedies, yet he opened up that he was “forced” to write them at that time. Later on, he wrote and co-directed “La Brassiere”, a film which entertains without being obscene. He reveals that one of the leading actor, Lau Ching Wan, complained to him afterwards... In this episode, Hing Kai is invited to share the untold stories from his writing career and talk about the changing ecology of screenwriting in the film industry.(n)

programme.title: 辣手回春
programme.desc: This is the first day of work for Yan at Sir Kau Kei Ho Charity Hospital's A&E. Yan is shocked to find that Jim, teaching her shedding job responsibility. An old man is taken to A&E after being struck by lightening. Each department dispatches him to one another but scrambling to take him after knowing that he is Ho Kau Kei. Ho wants to abolish the hospital's bureaucratic system, by appointing Yan, together with Joe and Jim to make changes by their own ways..(n)

programme.title: 黑貓
programme.desc: Catherine is a violent and disturbed young lady who is shot down by the government in one of her escapades. She wakes up in a training facility and is taught to use weapons, combat, and is put through heavy endurance training. When she is done, she is given the code name 'Black Cat'. Catherine is now an assassin for the government and is very good at it but she soon finds a boyfriend and is caught between her love for him and her deal with the government..(n)

programme.title: 著牛仔褲的鍾馗
programme.desc: Tsu, a police officer, has a happy life with his wife, who's pregnant. But one day when he gets a tip that a bank is about to be robbed, he rushes to it but killed. The hostage Gucci then holds the loot. Tsu becomes a vampire when a cat jumps on his body and is hit by lightning. Not until he went to the hospital did he realize he was dead and needs electric recharge to be alive. In order to keep his wife from being sad, he doesn't tell her the truth. Even when his best friend Mr. Big and Gucci find it out, he asks them to keep in secret. To get back the loot, the robbers seize both Gucci and Tsu's wife, forcing Tsu to bring the loot to exchange them..(n)

programme.title: 無限復活
programme.desc: Ren takes out his entire savings and persuades his best friend Sing to leave for Vegas with him. They challenge the most well respected dealer in town, and in just one round, Ren's wages is all wiped out. Ren and Sing begin their trip back to LA, but on the way their car mysteriously overturns and crashes, Sing is dead. Ren arrives home wearily to find a message on his answering machine that warns him not to go to Vegas. He decides to go back to Vegas to find out what really happened that killed Sing..(n)

programme.title: 跛豪
programme.desc: The story of Ho, a chinese peasant/slave worker who escapes to Hong Kong and becomes one of the most feared crime bosses in Hong Kong.(n)

programme.title: 星願
programme.desc: What if you are given a wish being the 60th billion person moving to 'Polaris' (or others call it 'Heaven'), will you do the same as Onion, who was blind and dumb when he's alive.(n)

programme.title: 蜀山
programme.desc: An army deserter Di Ming Qi, who was chased by vampires in the mountain of Zu. He was rescued by Master Ding Yin and became his pupil. When they were ambushed by the Blood Devil, devil chaser Xiao Ru and his pupil Yi Zhen came to their assistance. With the help of Master Chang Mei, they managed to hold off the Blood Devil but they need to find the Dual Swords to destroy it. Master Ding took the wounded Xiao Ru to Celestial Fort and sought help from the Mistress, but was in turned poisoned by the Blood Devil and he surrendered to the Dark Force. Will Di and Yi Chen find the Dual Swords and destroy the Blood Devil.(n)

programme.title: 我家有一隻河東獅

programme.desc: In the third installment of this comedy hit, Bill and his wife have become snobbish after they won the lottery in Canada. When they showed off their money at the bank to their friends, they lost it all during a bank robbery and had to move back to their small flat in the public housing estate. When Bill went for an audition at the TV station, he ran into his ex-girlfriend and got himself into trouble when his wife thought he was having an affair. Later, Bill was notified by the bank that they will be reimbursed for the money they lost in the robbery due to a security breach of the bank..(n)

programme.title: 烈火戰車
programme.desc: Andy is a seasoned motor-cycle driver. His ultimate goal is to enroll in Grand Prix Racing. But in a private race, a severe crash almost took Andy's life..(n)

programme.title: 龍兄虎弟
programme.desc: Jackie assists the Duke for his exploration of the armour. In his latest hunt, he succeeded to acquire the 'sacred sword'. The terrorists kidnapped his friend in exchange..(n)

programme.title: 我愛一碌葛
programme.desc: Kudzu, Mud Carp and Bean depend on each other for survival since their parents died. Kudzu, the eldest of three sisters, gave up her studies and runs a fish stall in Luen Yee Hui market to raise her two young sisters. She is a super fan of the famous Singer, Alex. Mud Carp, the second sister, becomes a lawyer after university. Her boyfriend, David, comes from a rich family. In view of this, she dares not tell David her family background even though they are planning to get married. Kudzu always hopes her youngest sister Bean, to further her studies but she falls in love with a middle-aged butcher, Wing. One day, Kudzu discovers that her good friend, Keung, has a long-lost brother, and comes to the hopeful conclusion that his lost brother is Alex. In the process of helping Keung to find his brother, the relationship between the three sisters changed..(n)

programme.title: 望夫成龍
programme.desc: Shek Kam Shui eloped to the city with his lover Ng Dai Tai. He becomes a diamond sales and was appraised by his senior, Nancy which finally destroys his marriage..(n)

programme.title: 屍家重地
programme.desc: On a remote island off Hong Kong, its rich and happy inhabitants are celebrating an annual ritual by staging an operatic show. The island is not productive but its people are rich. No wonder police chief Yuan Kuei becomes suspicious. He thinks he is sitting on top of a narcotics ring. His two men are ordered to watch closely movement of the opera people. Little does the chief know that actually the islanders are living off the loot their ancestors made by raiding a government gold galleon some centuries ago. They buried much of the treasure and a dormant vampire under a pagoda. Two actresses and a tutor from the troupe get to the pagoda by accident, followed by the three policemen..(n)

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯: 千王
programme.desc: Taiwanese swindler Mr. Giant loses in a poker match against Hong Kong swindler Wong Sheung Chin and they become sworn enemies. Meanwhile, Wong's apprentice Snake Wai meets Susan, a widow whom recently returned to Hong Kong from Singapore. Planning to con a big sum of money from her, Wai sets up a plan with his acquaintances Yam Sei-sung and Yip Mei-mei. However, Susan turns out to be a swindler as well. Unable to salvage a fortune from Susan, Wai, Sung and Mei become indebted to her. In desperation, Wai seeks help from his mentor and he has won back all the debts they owed Susan..(n)

programme.title: 夜驚魂
programme.desc: A cuckolded husband becomes a cross-dressing night stalker, compelled to strike down any women he sees wearing white fish-net stockings. Leaving a trail of dead bodies in his wake, he selects a female disc jockey as his next target..(n)

programme.title: 監獄風雲
programme.desc: The plot mostly involves the two main characters, Ching and Yiu and problems they face with Mickey, a fellow inmate and “Scarface”, a high-ranking officer. Yiu is sentenced to three years for manslaughter. In a fight for his father, he kicked a man onto the path of a bus. Ching was sent to prison for killing his wife for being a prostitute. During the end of the film, inmates decide to go on hunger strike to protest against the cigarette price rise, this causes problems with “Assassin”. Ching bit “Scarface”‘s ear off and gets an extended sentence, Yiu is released from the prison.(n)

programme.title: 衝激21
programme.desc: Ben, a young guy made himself well-known as the 'Red Devil' in illegal car racings. One night, his car sped alongside with Alan, who came from a rich family. Later they met again in a Disco through another friend. The next day, Alan had a duel with Ben but he gave up his chance of winning to save Ben from crashing onto a container truck. Thus commencing their friendship. One day, Ben had a fight with his mom then he left home. Ben headed to another race in the suburb, where he met a foreigner. They had some argument and Ben unintentionally killed the foreigner. The youngsters were scared and arranged for concealment to the corpse. Meanwhile, Alan and Mann planned for an escape. Others found out and rejected. The two forced to go on to a roof and in the confusion. Alan fell off the building and died. Other guys tried to escape. The critical circumstances forced these young men to dash into a supermarket. They held up the customers as hostages..(n)

programme.title: 流氓醫生
programme.desc: Dr. Mack Lau gives up his career in a famed hospital and opens a clinic in a run-down place. Not only does he heal the residences' wounds, but also their torn-and-broken hearts.(n)

programme.title: 龍兄虎弟
programme.desc: Jackie assists the Duke for his exploration of the armour. In his latest hunt, he succeeded to acquire the 'sacred sword'. The terrorists kidnapped his friend in exchange..(n)

programme.title: 驅魔警察
programme.desc: Lam, an experienced policeman, had his quiet and beautiful life in Tung Ping Chau. He often tackled criminal cases with his supernatural power. One day, the old lady living next door came to ask him to go Hong Kong Island to get back the dead body of her daughter, a stewardess who was killed by the police as being suspected to be a drug smuggler. Lam's niece, Lin, a young country girl, was very interested in the life of Hong Kong and decided to go with Lam. At the Police Station, Lam knew that the 'Stewardess' was killed by 2 police sergeants, Yin and Miu, after a desperate struggle. Lam explained that the 'Stewardess' had actually been killed before she came back to Hong Kong. She had been turned to be a living corpse and controlled by a Japanese magician for smuggling..(n)

programme.title: 飛鷹計劃
programme.desc: Jackie the Condor is having his adventures, and Baron calls on him for help. Baron gives him an assistant Chinese scholar Ada, to locate and take back the gold hidden by the Nazis.(n)

programme.desc: Imperial Court member Wai Siu-Bo is sent forward in time to present-day Hong Kong, to find a woman who can cure the Emperor of his illness. Can Siu-Bo accomplish his mission.(n)

programme.desc: Zhan's family was very rich, but his wife died early. He and his daughter Baby depended on each other. Zhan liked dancing in nightclub which his daughter opposed. Therefore, she dressed up to work in the nightclub in order to make her dad mad. A gangster had an interest in Baby, but fortunately Cong came forward to help. Baby and Cong developed feelings for each other. Baby used her wealth to help Cong with his career, but when Cong found out that his career was helped by Baby secretly, it was difficult for him to accept. How should Cong decide.(n)

programme.desc: The citizens of a small Chinese town suffer from failed crops and corrupt officials. Their salvation comes in the form of a Robin Hood figure, the Iron Monkey, who steals from the rich to give to poor. When martial arts master Wong Kay-ying arrives, his martial arts skills lead local lawmen to suspect that he may be the masked outlaw. Wong's son, Wong Fei-hung, is caught in the line of fire as he fights to clear his name. In the end, Wong and the Iron Monkey must join forces to face the real villain of the piece.(n)

programme.title: 聖誕奇遇結良緣
programme.desc: When the explosive expert Wong plans to deliver his new invention, a small bomb to someone, his assistant Lung is aware of the plot. But when Lung steals the bomb and wants to present it to the police, he killed by Wong and another two killers. A taxi driver, Chu, along with a chemist, Lam and a girl, Cat witness the murder scene, getting involved in it. Just prior to Lung death, he cleverly hides the bomb at a secret place and reveals the clues only to Cat. Being afraid that the three people might find out the bomb and ruin his plot, Wong appoints some killers to get rid of them. After going through a great deal of difficulties, the three people find out the bomb but Wong also knows their location..(n)

After Feng was out of prison, his father's old friend Wei took him home to stay temporarily. One day, Feng received mysterious phone message from a woman Qi, and then he began to be deeply in love with her. Under the guidance of Wei, a love expert, Feng finally won Qi's heart. Wei suddenly arrived while Feng and Qi were having their breakfast in bed..(n)

programme.desc: So, the legendary beggar, is actually born in a princely rich family. Like his father, So leads a lavish life. He once meets Ju Suan and falls in love with the virgin prostitute.(n)

programme.title: 天地雄心
programme.desc: As Ken (Andy Lau), one of the surviving scientists, tries to solve the unsolvable, he is haunted by the reappearance of his dead finace Adele (Michelle Reis).(n)

programme.desc: Chang and Ao are twin sisters. Ao is a lunatic and stays in a mental hospital. Chang is 'cheated' into the hospital, exchanging identity with her insane sister. The mad house is lived by all kinds of weirdos. The 'game' is that Chang will stay in the hospital only for a while. But strangely enough, she gradually becomes more and more ease with the way of life in the hospital until one day, she's forgotten what life is like outside, including her fiance. Meanwhile, Ao is out looking for her ex-husband Ma Shih-mei who heartlessly deserted her. She meets the postman who has a secret infatuation with Chang. She also makes an acquaintance with millionaire Sugar Old Man. The three of them develop the most harmonious friendship over..(n)

programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat plays a veteran inmate Chung Tin Ching. When serving his term, Ching's mother passed away his son is sent to an orphanage. When his application for leave is turned down, he breaks out of prison, further antagonizing the new Head of Security, played by Tsui Kam Kong. Chen Sung Yung plays a fellow inmate from the Mainland, Lung who befriends Ching. When he is framed for murder, Ching is implicated in fingering him. Ching and Lung must break out of prison to stay alive..(n)

programme.title: 賭后

Her target: a crooked investor and card shark extraordinaire. When Nan's underhanded opponent proves too much to handle on her own, she enlists the aid of some rather unusual helpers, including an overconfident casino playboy, a disastrously awkward stuntman, and a perky martial arts princess. Pooling their various talents, Nan concocts a crazy scheme to take down her adversary that is destined to go down in gambling history.(n)

programme.title: 十二夜
programme.desc: 12 particular nights, from falling in love to drifting apart to a tentative separation and, to the inevitable split, these nocturnal passages encapsulate the entire experience.(n)

programme.title: 金枝玉葉2
programme.desc: With the help of her lover, Sam, Wing impersonated a male image and became a pop singer. But Fong Yim Mui wrecked the relationship when they both had an affair with her..(n)

programme.title: 陰陽路4與鬼同行
programme.desc: Leonardo, DiCaprio and Driver joined a bargain tour to Philippines, hoping that they could feast all they could on the local girls as well as those traveling with them. They were excited to see that two wantons, U2 and K2 had joined their tour with a pretty tour guide Yan. They thought they would enjoy themselves, but in fact, they were heading for their death..(n)

programme.title: 江湖接班人
programme.desc: Sammy is a man of honour. He lives by the underworld's code of honour. He helps friends and kills enemies, for instance, Ng Kong who got him 3 years behind bars. Sammy is now a fugitive in Taiwan being protected by Kui, one of the gang leaders. Once Kui injures Peter, his opposition and young Crow takes the rap. Sammy and Crow become friends. Sammy tries to mediate between Kui and Peter but finds out being used by Kui to eliminate Peter. He wants out. But Crow joins Kui's gang after killing Peter. Sammy retires to Crow's home town and falls in love with his sister. Kui begins to turn against Crow. He sends Crow to Hong Kong and orders to kill him. Crow escapes back to Taiwan, only to find his girlfriend has committed suicide after Kui's gang has raped her. At the same moment, Kui's men come for him and kill his sister who comes with Sammy to deliver their wedding news. With Sammy by his side, Crow starts his vendetta..(n)

programme.title: 至尊三十六計之偷天換日
programme.desc: Mindy is a top-notched gambler. During a card game, Mindy swindle millions of dollars, but they are caught. Lau makes a deal with Mindy that Mindy needs to go to prison..(n)

programme.title: 神算
programme.desc: Michael Hui returned to the director's chair in more than 7 years. In this sci-fi comedy, Michael plays fortune-telling can artist who turned out to really “see the future”..(n)

programme.desc: To fight against the new era criminals, Inspector Chan struggles for picking up a group of brand new cadets to become his new team called the 'Gen-X-Cops'..(n)

programme.title: 香江花月夜

His teacher however, fell from his golden days. As the teacher realized that “Nothing Lasts Forever”, he was content with his quiet and simple life. The story took place in a night club in the sixties. Zhang Jiawing was a cheerful kid. His best friend Gao Zhi was a shoe boy. Gao‘s father disappeared after losing all his money in stock speculation. The two kids became students to the once renowned singer Johnny, whose career was at low ebb. Johnny had great hopes on them. He vowed to make them become the best of the best..(n)

programme.title: 英雄本色II
programme.desc: Former criminal, Tse-Ho (Ti Lung) is set free from his incarceration in jail to assist in the investigation of his former crime boss, Lung (Dean Shek), who is suspected of running a counterfeit operation. Though initially refusing, he only agrees so he can keep a close eye on his cop brother Kit (Leslie Cheung), who is working undercover to infiltrate Lung's organization. After Lung is framed for the murder of a rival gang leader, he turns to Tse-Ho, who helps him escape to New York where he is joined by Ken (Chow Yun Fat), the equally deadly twin brother of the deceased Mark. Returning to Hong Kong to rejoin Tse-Ho and Kit, they soon discover the true mastermind behind the entire operation, and in true John Woo fashion, set out to take him down.(n)

programme.title: 鐵妹
programme.desc: The Story is set in the period during the Japanese invasion of China in the 1930's. A Chinese traitor Tung working within the puppet state of Manchukuo, gets involved in an affair with the mistress of a military officer. Their affair is exposed and in the confusion, Tung kills the officer and has to flee from the Japanese. In the desolate arid lands, his life is saved by Iron Sister, a member of guerrillas from a nearby hunting village, whom has an affair later with Tung. The humble villagers are very simple minded and only wished to drive out the Japanese. They fall easy prey, as Tung disguises his real identity and continues his secret contacts with his collaborators. One by one, the villagers become victims of Tung's ploy. Accidentally his plot is discovered by Iron Sister and they engage in a battle of life and death.(n)

programme.title: 龍之家族
programme.desc: Hong Kong's godfather Dragon family believes his underworld should turn legitimate. His four 'families' support him but the 'pusher' violates the agreement. Dragon has him executed in public. But White Wolf No.2 in command, starts to challenge the old man. His two assistants, Joseph and Kirl, who intend to take over the narotic trade, set a trap for Tom, one of Dragon's six sons. In the melee, Kirl kills Dragon. Joseph persuades White Wolf to a massacre of the Dragon Family and the four 'families' during the funeral. At the same times, he kills White Wolf and sets his foot in the high society..(n)

programme.title: 盲女七十二小時
programme.desc: Heung is temporarily blinded by an accident. While her doctor husband leaves Hong Kong for a meeting, an uninvited man arrives at their house. The man teases and tortures Heung, claiming that he is coming to avenge his wife..(n)

programme.title: 半斤八兩
programme.desc: Joseph Wong (Michael Hui), the kingpin of the Manix Private Detective Agency, a firm believer in tact and thrift. By tact, he means you can cheat all the people all the time and corners are there to be cut. By thrift, he means an underpaid staff is happy and grateful staff. By chance, he employs Lee Kwok Kit (Samuel Hui). Together, they have solved lots of wired cases. One day, while the two are investigating a blackmail case, the movie goes off and the lights come on. Scores of gun-toting hoods hold the more than 1,000 goers as hostages. On the stage Uncle Gaw (Shek Kin) threatens that it is a hold-up.(n)

programme.title: 幻影特攻
programme.desc: Two CIA researchers undergo 'VR Fighter training' in order to save a kidnapped colleague. The training is designed to change an unskilled agent into a magnificent combat agent.(n)

programme.title: 大丈夫日記
programme.desc: In this delightful screwball comedy, Chow Yun Fat plays a stock broker who met 2 women of his dream on the same night - boutique owner Joey (Joey Wang) and air stewardess Sally (Sally Yeh). Unable to say no to either one, he ended up marrying them both, one in New York and the other in Paris. When the wives befriended each other, he solicited the help from his buddy Hung (Waise Lee) to get him out of each tight spot.(n)

programme.title: 狼吻夜驚魂
programme.desc: One night, DJ Zhou Meishi received a phone call from an audience named “hungry wolf”. He told her he hated the world and he would burn down the hospital in which he was born. The next day, a hospital was being set fire on. Then “hungry wolf” called again and declared he would burn down his kindergarten and there followed really an explosion. And according to “hungry wolf”, the next target would be Zhou. Chief Wang was appointed to investigate into the case and to protect Zhou. On the other hand, since Zhou suspected “hungry wolf” to be a luster, she reacted strangely and made a lot of jokes during the course of the investigation..(n)

programme.title: 洪熙官
programme.desc: Hung Hei Kwun, a kungfu student of Shaolin, is against the Manchu rulers. Hong's whole family was arrested and later beheaded. Hong killed Ning-Erh Ma in revenge and escaped with his youngest son, Man-Ting , to nowhere land. Several years later, Chishan, Father Superior of the Shaolin Temple, found a map to a treasure trove but contents were tattooed on the backs of his five young masters. If missing one master, the trove could not be found..(n)

programme.title: 別戀
programme.desc: Young architect Rick treats love as a game. One day, while he was checking out the poster of writer Lok Ching-I's new book, he got hit by a car..(n)

programme.title: 神探磨轆
programme.desc: Lau Ching Wan was in the force for almost ten years. He was very careless and was termed 'Detective Idiot' by his colleagues. One day, he came to the knowledge that his boss, Christine Ng was a lesbian. Nevertheless, they became good friends and treated each other like brothers. Unfortunately, Lau fell in love with Ng's girlfriend and they had an affair. Then, Ng found that she too has fallen for Lau which further complicated the matter. The three were thrown into conflicts. On the other hand, they accidentally discovered Prosecutor Ng Chun Yue was taking the laws into his own hands and this led them into serious troubles.......(n)

programme.title: 少林英雄之方世玉洪熙官
programme.desc: The August of Ching Dynasty Emperor Keen-Lung thirty-second year, general Ko Chun Chung got the help from Master White-Eyebrow and his two apprentices Kam Fung Cheung and Cheung Man Cheung to destroy Shaolin temple, but it was quite regretful some Monks including Hung Hei Kwun has escaped. After that the Emperor Keen-Lung promoted Ko Chun Chung as Guangzhou Governor and to get rid of all the people of Hung's group. In order to reunion Ming Dynasty, Hung hided himself in a red boat. One day, he went to town and saved young Fung Sai Yuk..(n)

programme.title: 賭俠
programme.desc: Little Knife is following in his master's footsteps and rapidly rising in th gambling world. Sing Chi would like to be the God of Gamblers' disciple and ask him for help..(n)

programme.title: 我要活下去
programme.desc: Bei Yan and Wen Zixiang grew up together and were meant to be a pair. However, Yan needed money for her grandmother who was very sick. So she married a well-to-do man in England. She had to run the restaurant for her husband and took care of their disabled daughter Ye Fan. Yet her impotent husband often abused her..(n)

programme.title: 金牌寫手：陳慶嘉: 吳三桂與陳圓圓
programme.desc: Chan Tai Yuen had planned to migrate to Canada, he found out that his wife was having an affair with a foreigner. Chan had already transferred the ownership of the house and the car to his wife. Suddenly Chan lost everything. Chan met Ng Sam Kwi, Chan had nowhere to go and thus moved into Ng's house. They gradually fell in love with each other. Would Ng change herself for her love.(n)

programme.title: 痴情快婿
programme.desc: Leon busts an international drug ring at Singapore in a startling fight sequence that will shock even the most jaded filmgoer. From there on it's laughs galore when Leon arrives on Hong Kong with his wife to be who is then kidnapped by her own father who objects to her marrying a police officer. Frankie Chan immediately comes to the aid of his long time friend and in a series of exciting sequences they pursue Leon's missing fiance. Together they encounter her father's bumbling gangster, the vivaciously devious Sharon Kwok, and a team of deadly western agents sent to destroy them. In an explosive finale laughter takes a backseat to tension as the two battle overwhelming odds and just when all appears lost Frankie comes to the rescue.(n)

programme.title: Space Farmers 第1季
programme.desc: Space foods, initially created just for astronauts, has now facilitated a revolution in agricultural and alternative food production. This revolution is changing the way we think about producing food in the future. In Finland, protein-rich foods are produced from thin air, making food production possible in a variety of environments, including deserts, cities, and even outer space. Scientists in the United States are working to make mushroom cultivation more sustainable, while in Austria, seeds are exposed to space radiation to improve their yield when grown back on Earth. A startup in Singapore is using space technology to enhance the security of livestock herds, and at NUS, a team has developed a remarkable hydrogel that makes crop cultivation more water-efficient.(n)

programme.title: River Hunters 第1季第6集 -Barnard Castle -River Tees- Elizabethan Siege
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters at the edge of one of Britain’s greatest castles, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards - and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette - battle the forceful River Tees. In the first archaeological river search of this spot ever, they’ll be searching for lost Tudor relics from a gruesome 16th siege at Barnard Castle and secrets of this ancient borderland. programme.title: Save This Shark 第1季
programme.desc:
3x World Surf Champion turned wildlife conservationist Mick Fanning teams up with leading experts in new documentary SAVE THIS SHARK. 
Mick Fanning is on a new mission to explore shark conservation. The 3x world surfing champion will hop around the world teaming up with experts and conservationists to uncover the hidden truths about sharks, threats and how to save them from extinction. 
Mick will investigate the issue of sharks versus people and present problems as well as discover the latest technological solutions in how to keep both humans and sharks safe to coexist. Our host has had some incredible achievements throughout his professional career, but one moment stood out to the world live on television in 2015. 
A shark encounter at the J-Bay Open saw Mick Fanning become ‘the guy who punched a shark’. A huge part of saving sharks is convincing people that they need our help and putting aside the fear factor. In Save This Shark, Mick takes this incredible opportunity to go on his ow.(n)

programme.title: Save This Shark 第1季
programme.desc:
3x World Surf Champion turned wildlife conservationist Mick Fanning teams up with leading experts in new documentary SAVE THIS SHARK. 
Mick Fanning is on a new mission to explore shark conservation. The 3x world surfing champion will hop around the world teaming up with experts and conservationists to uncover the hidden truths about sharks, threats and how to save them from extinction. 
Mick will investigate the issue of sharks versus people and present problems as well as discover the latest technological solutions in how to keep both humans and sharks safe to coexist. Our host has had some incredible achievements throughout his professional career, but one moment stood out to the world live on television in 2015. 
A shark encounter at the J-Bay Open saw Mick Fanning become ‘the guy who punched a shark’. A huge part of saving sharks is convincing people that they need our help and putting aside the fear factor. In Save This Shark, Mick takes this incredible opportunity to go on his ow.(n)

programme.title: Save This Rhino 第1季
programme.desc: Kevin Pietersen (KP) invites Matt Wright to South Africa, to visit the Kruger National Park area, and show him the state of play and understand the world of poaching. Aside from his success in cricket, KP has also been a fierce and passionate member of the global choir singing to save the rhino. It’s Matt’s first time in South Africa, but it’s not the first time he’s had to face the problem of endangered species. They will meet baby Arthur, who lost his mum to poaching alongside many other baby rhinos who suffered the same fate. Angered and emotional at this dire situation, KP and Matt seek answers to why people would do this. It’s an emotional experience, and it cements the need to find solutions fast, and there may be one already. \nWhat becomes blatantly obvious is that the problem is challenging and solutions convoluted.(n)

programme.title: River Hunters 第1季第6集 -Barnard Castle -River Tees- Elizabethan Siege
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters at the edge of one of Britain’s greatest castles, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards - and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette - battle the forceful River Tees. In the first archaeological river search of this spot ever, they’ll be searching for lost Tudor relics from a gruesome 16th siege at Barnard Castle and secrets of this ancient borderland. In the 1500s, this was where North battled South in a grizzly attempt to overthrow Queen Elizabeth I and claim the throne for Mary, Queen of Scots.(n)

programme.title: Space Farmers 第1季
programme.sub-title: Food For Space Helps Planet Earth
programme.desc: How will research to live in space in the future benefit us on Earth today? In the Netherlands, we meet a team of researchers working with Martian and Lunar soil to grow crops and mealworms as food. In Thailand, scientists test the effects of varying gravity on the next superfood - watermeal. Meanwhile, an astounding transformation of agriculture is underway in Australia, with crop cultivation methods increasing output by 100%. With a cultivated beef firm in Israel racing to grow meat in space and a Singaporean company using microalgae to produce protein-rich foods, we learn how less is more for food production. Inspired by the similarity between disaster areas and outer space, a Japanese entrepreneur creates jellies to provide nutrition to earthquake victims and astronauts. As the space industry in Singapore grows, collaborations between countries and students’ interests in outer space deepen, leading to a transformation in space-for-humanity research.(n)

programme.title: River Hunters 第1季第7集 -Durham - Henry VIII
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards - and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette take on the stunning River Wear - a natural fortress protecting the ancient city of Durham and its sacred Cathedral. This is where in the 1500’s, Henry VIII seized power of the Church and the Cathedral’s shrines were plundered. Now Rick and Beau, joined by Durham’s diving archeologist Gary Bankhead, are hunting for hidden treasures to uncover evidence of what life was like from this majestic city’s turbulent past.(n)

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -留尼旺島之旅
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo are surprised by wasps during lunch. Alim says they should be happy to see them. To explain, he takes them to Reunion Island. During a picnic, a swarm of wasps causes panic, but Zoe and Milo learn that on this island, wasps are actually a popular delicacy.(n)

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -印度之旅
programme.desc: For hamsters' day, Zoe and Milo want to surprise Alim by making confetti to throw on their little friend. But Alim knows a place on earth where people celebrate by throwing something more interesting than confetti up in the air. Our heroes land in Rajasthan, India.(n)

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -韓國之旅
programme.desc: Zoe's mum doesn't like cakes, so Zoe isn't sure what to make for her birthday. Alim suggests visiting their penfriend Kachiko, who lives in South Korea. They meet up with her on the beach.(n)

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -慶祝吧

programme.category: Adventure, Educational, Self Improvement, Animation / nan

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -里歐有毒

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -居家改善

programme.title: 科學量販店 -尋找微乎其微的微生物
programme.desc: How can microbes be of use at a birthday party? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of microorganisms. Have hands-on fun by experimenting with yeast, and get to know Satoshi Omura, a biochemist, who discovered medicine inside miniscule microbes.(n)

programme.title: 科學量販店 -環境科學

programme.title: 44隻貓第一季 -記者貓嘉比

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -來吧!愛波

programme.title: 大灣區會客廳
programme.desc: “Talk With Claire About Great Bay Area” is a bilingual interview program on Shenzhen TV that focuses on in-depth exploration and research. With a global perspective on the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, it captures cutting-edge trends in economic and trade exchanges, technological innovation, cultural trends, and more between China and the world. Through on-site research and interviews, the program engages in conversations with leaders from government, business, technology, and cultural sectors. It showcases technological achievements, trends in economic and trade exchanges, and mutual learning in civilization exchanges. Since its inception over two years ago, “Talk With Claire About Great Bay Area” has aired more than a hundred episodes of specialized interviews. The program integrates prominent international figures into the Greater Bay Area, where guests draw from their personal experiences living and working in the area or provide professional perspectives o.(n)

programme.title: 粵菜大師
programme.desc: Masters of Cantonese Cuisine is a documentary on Lingnan (Guangdong) delicacies culture, originally created by Shenzhen Satellite TV. This is a brief history of food belonging to the Greater Bay Area, a history of customs and culture that belongs exclusively to Guangdong. The program focus on the local Guangdong delicacies, and led by a “delicacy searcher”, walking through streets in search of local specialities, visiting masters of Cantonese cuisines, and sharing unique tasting commentaries. In the meantime, the reflection on delicacies would be brought back to live studio, and two observers who are proficient in Cantonese cuisine cultures will have chats on tasting. From a spoon and a drop, it will extend to the taste of life and origin of culture embedded in the delicacies.(n)

programme.title: 詩意中國民謠與詩歌的遠行
programme.desc: The sixth season of 'Poetic China' seamlessly weaves the tapestry of Chinese classical poetry with the adventurous spirit of travel, with music serving as the keystone. In collaboration with esteemed national artists, the series ventures across the breathtaking landscapes of our great nation-mountains and seas alike-to listen to the whispering winds and the lullabies of the ocean's depths. These experiences inspire the creation of healing songs that embody the unique charm, merging the rich legacy of Chinese musical traditions with the distinctive urban identity. The program showcases the contemporary urban healing trend through a timeless melody that resonates across the ages. With the solemn duty to 'communicate the beauty of life through poetry,' the show endeavors to cultivate 'cultural confidence among the Chinese people.' Anchored in the vibrant characteristics of Shenzhen, it forges a new television format that is youthful, avant-garde, and engaging.(n)

香港代表作
programme.desc: 家傳戶曉的白花油，原來有很多事情你未必知道，例如可否口服？民間偏方又有哪些真的有效？節目為你一一驗證；白花油的宣傳以出位見證，原來早在五六年代他們的宣傳招數更出位！這家超過九十年的本地品牌將如何傳承？「白花油王子」顏福偉為大家剖白。.(n)

programme.title: 開飯啦
programme.desc: 冬蔭功可算是最經典、最多人認識的泰國菜! 味道酸酸辣辣，裡面有大量香料和配料，飲完令人超滿足，愈辣愈想飲!要數最多人熟悉的西式意粉，雞皇白汁意粉，相信一定是三甲之選! 今次選用米形粉，煮法簡單，配香濃白汁，味道真是攞足滿分!李偉強 泰式冬蔭功材料：大.(n)

programme.title: 茶餐廳龍虎榜
programme.desc: 茶餐廳龍虎榜第三味，焗飯！焗飯是茶餐廳的最暢銷之選，雖然要等，但往往有驚喜。而提到焗飯，不得不試焗豬。主持張紋嘉Crystal繼續偕鄧穎芝試吃最地道焗飯！她帶着大廚給的貼士回到廚房，跟Amy試煮豪華版焗豬，到底她們能否成功煮出地道風味焗豬呢？.(n)

programme.title: 中國光大集團呈獻 : 一線搜查
煮題COOK之舟山美食搜遊
programme.desc: 今集兩位主持會參觀位於舟山朱家尖的”觀音法界”, 這個集朝聖、觀光 、體驗、於一體的宗教文化景區, 建築非常宏偉, 而且極富藝術性,殿內千手千眼觀音及環繞穹頂, 一共有216尊佛像以不同形態呈現, 有如星辰散佈, 可以說是佛教文化與藝術完美結合, 難.(n)

programme.title: 健康關注組
programme.desc: 男士患上前列腺增生情況相當普遍，有人40歲就已經出現相關症狀，發病率更會隨年齡遞增，51至60歲的男性，大約有50%出現前列腺增生，而70歲就約有70%，到了80歲以上，幾乎90%都會患上前列腺增生。如果不處理增生的問題，有可能出現尿路感染、膀胱結石.(n)

programme.title: 黑白大廚滋味行
programme.desc: 在這次比賽的黑隊師傅之中有幾位的餐廳都是已經被米芝連指南推薦的，好比這間位在漢南洞安靜小巷內的墨西哥餐廳就是其中之一。主廚在節目裡被稱為「韓國塔克餅 King」絕不是虛有其名，在墨西哥研究當地料理後帶回韓國，從taco餅皮、經典的黑醬都堅持自己製作。.(n)

programme.title: 香港代表作
programme.desc: 香港本地設計師麥雅端，在不顧家人的反對下，於2000年創立自家品牌Chocolate Rain，她憑住一顆童心及初心，親手製作出獨一無二的手工作品。2012年榮獲香港傑青，花了9年才打進香港市場，最近還協助翻新沙田交通安全公園，BabyJohn還跟她.(n)

programme.title: 茶餐廳龍虎榜
programme.desc: 茶餐廳龍虎榜第四味，滑蛋飯！茶餐廳很多食物跟蛋有關，而最考功夫的，當然是炒滑蛋。主持張紋嘉Crystal跟劉沛蘅親嚐滋味滑蛋飯，但究竟她能否在口風嚴密的餐廳負責人身上學得一招半式？努力搵料的Crystal跟Amy又能否在家中廚房重現美味滑蛋風呢？.(n)

programme.title: 中國光大集團呈獻 : 一線搜查
煮題COOK之舟山美食搜遊
programme.desc: 舟山大黃魚, 愛吃魚的人都愛,魚肉細嫩白滑, 魚香味鮮! 在舟山"六橫島"有一個規模很大、又非常現代化的海洋牧場, 場內飼養的大黃魚品質極高, RICKY 形容是他嘗過最優質的。兩位主持參觀完整個魚場, 了解黃魚養殖後, 還即場現撈了一條大黃魚來烹煮.(n)

programme.title: 健康關注組
programme.desc: 踏入秋冬季節，天氣乾燥，唇瘡與唇炎，雙雙爆發！嘴唇疼痛紅腫，岀小水泡都只是表面病徵，嚴重情況，會引發其他併發症，影響神經系統，康復之後，仍然有復發高風險！今集就有皮膚科專科醫生與中醫師，教大家不同的應對方法，而健康小百科，有運動神經科學博士Dr. T.(n)

programme.title: 自煮女人最漂亮
programme.desc: 眾所周知鄭欣宜（Joyce）是識煮識食之人，近年更進軍飲食業，售賣軟曲奇、雪糕、蛋糕及咖啡等，但今次Joyce接受彭秀慧（Kearen）邀請到《自煮女人最漂亮》做嘉賓，製作的食譜更大大考起Joyce，究竟她們二人最後能否順利完成？.(n)

programme.title: 雷頓 不可思議偵探社 ～卡特莉的解謎事件簿～
香港代表作
programme.desc: 自1904年起，電車幾乎毫不間斷的服務香港島市民，更成為歷史文化標記。電車上，乘客各有故事，有電車迷、有城市攝影愛好者、有老街坊，他們眼中的電車是怎樣？BabyJohn將置身古老的「120型號」電車上，欣賞電車與香港的情懷。.(n)

programme.title: 茶餐廳龍虎榜
programme.desc: 茶餐廳龍虎榜第五味，蛋牛治三文治！茶餐廳用方包用得淋漓盡致，無限款式三文治，烘底更香口，炸埋變西多士。Crystal跟Regen試吃蛋牛治、西多士！她跟Amy在試煮期間，更意外研製出特色梯形西多士作茶記招牌菜？.(n)

programme.title: 中國光大集團呈獻 : 一線搜查
煮題COOK之舟山美食搜遊
programme.desc: 梭子蟹, 在舟山以至全國, 名氣都很大, 據資料顯示舟山梭子蟹產量超過全國一半, 品質更是公認的好。今集兩位主持繼續與好友"朱醫生"去沈家門國際水產城附近一間著名食店品嗜頭手梭子蟹的不同滋味, 還有用鯧魚煮的舟山年糕, 鮮味與米香結合,嫩滑與煙韌的碰.(n)

programme.title: 健康關注組
programme.desc: 如果容易瘀傷、不明原因出血，活動之後關節腫脹，流血之後難以止血，這些情況都是血友病的病徵，現時全球有超過40萬名血友病患者，而香港大概有超過200人，患上血友病，究竟血友病患者，是否不可以做運動，因為萬一受傷就大件事，今集就由醫生為大家分析血友病的成.(n)

programme.desc: 老婆餅由香港恆香餅家率先製造出售，受歡迎的程度足以結束酒家本業，而專門做唐餅。將近百年的老店曾經有過一段負面的消息，差點就保不住這品牌。首次爆光的年青新管理人，希望保留手作的工藝傳承，讓唐餅發揚光大；BabyJohn還初嘗手製老婆餅及蛋卷。.(n)

programme.title: 茶餐廳龍虎榜
programme.desc: 茶餐廳龍虎榜第六味，乾炒牛河！終於要一戰茶餐廳的鑊氣經典，乾炒牛河點炒先乾身不膩，口感豐富？重要試埋紀典茶飲，牛肉茶、滾水蛋！屋企廚房無明火，點可以炒出鑊氣？Crystal跟Amy又能唔能夠挑戰成功？.(n)

programme.title: 中國光大集團呈獻 : 一線搜查
煮題COOK之舟山美食搜遊
programme.desc: 舟山普陀山是著名景點, 去普陀山除了拜觀音, 當然不能錯過當地的素菜。兩位主持選了一間開設在精品民宿內的餐廳,那裡 無論環境、設計跟食物都很有驚喜, 前菜已經很殊不簡單, 水果蓮藕味道和質地都叫人意外, 最喜出望外可能是一道看不穿的菜式, 一卷卷插在.(n)

programme.title: 健康關注組
programme.desc: 當進行完性行為，如果男士發現避孕套的精液，呈現紅色，一定會非常震驚，為什麼會有血？那裡出問題？到底是患上甚麼病，血精症常被誤以為有性功能障礙、過度縱慾、自慰過度頻繁、或腎功能有問題等。其實病因眾多，泌尿外科專科醫生會詳細講解，另外健康小百科，中醫師會.(n)

programme.title: 開飯啦
programme.desc: 想煮簡單西餐，海鮮是最佳配搭! 「帶子」煮法多變，就算是入廚新手，都保證可以零失敗! 今次大廚教你配搭蔬菜蓉，襯托帶子的鮮甜，味道一定攞足滿分! 「蜆肉」同樣是西餐常見食材，大廚示範 「白酒蜆肉海鮮意粉」，鮮味加上酒香，你怎可以錯過!李安生 香煎帶子.(n)

programme.title: 宜居住遊行
programme.desc: 對港人來說，地球上應該沒有第二個地方，像馬來西亞一樣溝通零障礙，再加上門檻極低的第二家園計劃，彈出彈入無難度。來到港人最愛首選檳城，由姜皓文太太殷寧帶Crystal 睇盡她多年來的心水樓盤，見識極盡浮誇的設計。即將移民檳城的姜氏伉儷，最愛的檳城味道又.(n)

programme.title: 立邦抗甲醛淨味兒童漆系列特約 : 空間改造王
programme.desc: 東京都葛飾區，而家仲保留住老社區風情嘅住宅區，有家人為住宅問題而煩惱，就係柴田家，柴田，喺過咗身嘅父母手中，承繼屋齡四十八年嘅公寓兼住宅嘅屋企，不過，喺一樓嘅四間出租公寓，鐵欄杆生銹斷裂，用鋼骨架製成嘅露台，睇落隨時冧落嚟。由下面支撐一樓四個房間嘅露.(n)

programme.desc: 今集同大家了解室內設計點樣令生活提升！一間近60年的舊式住宅單位經過裝修同大翻新之後，設計如何讓單位內外外表煥然一新，在佈局上又迎合這個年代的生活需要？外表提升同時，舊樓裝修最大的工程是內部結構，設計師Primus將會教大家怎樣去檢查及維修看不到的內.(n)

programme.title: 香港保險業聯會呈獻 : In Café 健康．保障360
programme.desc: 做運動不時會發生意外。根據衛生署《非故意損傷統計調查》，有14.2%意外於「餘暇時間進行運動」發生。15至24歲青少年及成人經歷的損傷事件中更有高達37.4%。本集《In Café 健康•保障360》請來香港保險業聯會副主席尹玄慧女士，與我們分享運動.(n)

英國邊忽好
programme.desc: 英國人如何過公眾假期？詩詠初次體驗在英國除外倒數，嘗試去免費看煙花的地點，與眾人普天同慶觀賞煙花。她亦在1月1走到唐人街吃點心，亦找到居住英國的香港人，跟他們做英國人過節會做的事 - 行山！到底除外煙花美不美？假期過得充不充實？.(n)

programme.desc: 全首爾最大嘅肉類批發中心、招待外國首相嘅豪華燒肉店、每星期去拍賣會入貨嘅高級扒房...今集兩位「港女」搜羅咗首爾入面最多人講，最多人like 同 share嘅韓牛餐廳，將韓牛嘅唔同部位、唔同食法由平到貴全部食一次！.(n)

programme.desc: 東京都葛飾區有家人為住宅問題而煩惱，就係柴田家。川口請柴田向草地棒球隊隊友收集大量嘅舊衫返嚟之後，嚟到靜岡縣某間工廠。喺呢度有好多人同佢哋一樣帶舊衫嚟放喺工廠，其實呢度，係全國家庭同纖維工廠，每年，收集返嚟嘅舊衫有四千噸，工匠請柴田收集番嚟嘅呢四箱舊.(n)

programme.desc: 臥底變餓底，阿正、妹姐今集味蕾大爆發！兩人潛入香港秘魯餐廳，一開場就畀「Tiger’s Milk」酸撼全場，阿正更懷疑自己飲咗能量飲品？！最後仲驚見熟人埋佢哋單！轉場去日本殿堂級Omakase，妹姐一路食一路high爆金句！究竟食啲咩食到兩個人興奮到.(n)

無界超越殘特奧
programme.sub-title: #4伯樂遇上千里「划」—殘疾賽艇運動員曾星
programme.desc: 今年16歲、印度裔中學生曾星 Kang Sukhman Singh在香港土生土長，出生時因為脊柱問題而不能走路，從少到大都是以輪椅代步，他沒有特別喜好的運動，直至遇上他的划艇「伯樂」陳敏謙教練。. 教練指曾星初試划艇就展出天賦，展現出堅毅的耐力，訓練成績非常出色，經過少於一年的訓練，曾星將會初試啼聲，首次參加今屆殘運會殘疾賽艇PR 1 級別賽事（PR1級別指艇手只可運用肩膀和雙手），年紀輕輕的他是如何接受訓練呢？學校如何支援他？教練對這位年輕殘疾運動員有甚麼期望呢？主持成家宏和温嘉希還會跟曾星一同划艇。. 《拼搏無界限》環節會介紹廣東省殘疾人鐵人三項運動員張健及楊曉婷.

programme.title: 迎戰全國運動會(三) - 運動明星玩過界
programme.sub-title: 第三集：高爾夫球 （嘉賓：劉知名）
programme.desc: 一位球手，一場數小時，完成18洞的比賽。高爾夫球比賽的規則簡單明瞭，卻引人入勝！. 過去賽事習慣赤手空拳的空手道運動員劉知名，今次接受高爾夫球訓練，學習揮桿，嘗試這項富有紳士傳統的運動。由認識「小鳥」、「老鷹」等專業術語，到學習揮桿入洞，每步都充滿挑戰！在最後比賽中，劉知名能否超額完成呢.

programme.title: 捨不得星星
programme.desc: 在海鮮市場裏，蔣時延家的海鮮攤位前擺起了長桌，班上一眾同學在這裏慶祝畢業。蔣時延向唐漾保證，他這輩子都會是她的好兄弟！轉眼唐漾終於調回匯商銀行蓉城分行信審處任副處長.

programme.title: 迎戰全國運動會 (四) - 行走十五運
programme.desc: 孫中山先生的故鄉——中山，是擁有豐富歷史文化的名城，城內風貌充滿獨特的歷史氣息；反之，與香港一橋之隔的海濱城市——珠海，科技正在高速發展。今屆全運會，中山市將會承辦棒球、壘球及五人制女子18歲以下組別籃球賽事，珠海則與香港及澳門攜手，舉辦跨越三地的公路自行車賽事，打破界限。. 曾獲中國職業棒球聯賽「盜壘王」的中山棒球運動員何銓豐，本集將與香港棒球代表隊副隊長鄭鎧霆，深入感受中山的歷史文化：體驗有著數百年歷史的醉龍舞表演、於聞名全國的熊貓棒球場切磋球技、品嚐最天然的「中山之甜」—神灣菠蘿。. 二人更走到充滿科技感的珠海，拜訪世界蹼泳冠軍李詠珊，彼此交流運動員的心路歷程之餘，亦探索珠海市的未來面貌.

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康 II
programme.sub-title: #3 令人又怕又愛的養生寶物 - 蛇
programme.desc: 蛇不是居家常用到的食材，不少人一聽到就「怯一怯」，不過香港一到冬天，蛇舖門口必定大排長龍，一碗蛇羹加一碗臘味飯，是很多香港人的進補秘方。. 今集主持羅鈺文和Andy Dark 衝出廚房，去到蛇王舖頭，除了近距離「親親」活蛇，廚師Andy Dark 更加跟「女蛇王」嘉玲姐偷師，學習如何拆蛇肉和煮蛇羹，了解本地的飲食歷史和文化之餘，更與蔡瀚億(BabyJohn)、錢穎儀中醫師邊品嘗蛇肉菜式，邊談養生進補之道。節目中還有飲食學者講解食蛇的文化歷史，以及營養師教教大家食蛇的注意事項。. 主持：羅鈺文(Yuki)、Andy Dark. 嘉賓：蔡瀚億(BabyJohn)、錢穎儀博士（香港浸會大學中醫藥學院臨床部中醫臨床副教授/註冊中醫.

programme.title: 31看世界 – 體積的奧妙
programme.desc: 到了第二集《目窮至大》，占得以看到更為大型的宇宙超結構，揭示我們對宇宙理解的最新突破。例如太陽圈，是充滿大陽能電漿的雲狀聚合物，圍繞並且保衞著太陽系，這種獨特的物理運作，有助我們明白生命如何出現。跳往更大的規模，占更與我們在星際的家——銀河——打了個照面。這是個奇異的結構，由暗物質的引力塑造出來。占又與先鋒研究員安德魯．費邊見面，明白黑洞中央位置各樣奇異的行為，例如能夠發出世界上最低的音符。此外，占又看見拉尼亞凱亞超星系團，相比之下銀河系實在十分渺少。在這以上，又有“巨大星系弧”，是集結了多個星系的結構，範圍大至延展到整個可見宇宙的百分之三。英國博士生艾莉茜亞．洛佩斯的這個巨大發現，驅使科學家重新審視有關宇宙演化的理論，甚至可能推翻部分物理學的基本原則。. In the “Going Big” episode, Jim encounters ever larger cosmic structures to reveal the latest breakthroughs in our understanding of the universe. For example, there’s the heliosphere, a vast cloud of solar plasma which surrounds and protects the solar system. Its unique physics will help us understand how life is possible. Larger still, Jim comes face to face with our galactic home, the Milky Way, a monstrous structure sculpted by the gravitational forces of dark matter. From pioneering researcher, Andrew Fabian, Jim finds out about the black hole at its centre whose strange behaviour includes emitting the lowest note ever heard in the cosmos. At an even greater scale, Jim will encounter huge structures such as the Laniakea galactic super-cluster of which the Milky Way is a tiny part. Then there’s “the giant arc”, a collection of galaxies which spans more than 3 per cent of the observable universe. From its discoverer, British PhD student Alexia Lopez, Jim finds out this gargantuan structure is forcing scientists to reassess their theory of how the universe evolves and may overturn some of the most fundamental principles in physics.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 提起環保建築，市民大眾大多會聯想到太陽能板，或者種植多一些花花草草以達綠化環境之效呢？其實建築物當中埋藏着很多建築師、園境師、工程師的巧思妙想，用各種方法及物料去減低碳排放。這集《學人沙龍》會帶大家探討一下可持續建築環境如何應對全球暖化的問題。. 主持：. 陳元敬(園境師). 董正綱(建築師). 潘浩倫(建築師). 嘉賓主持：. 郭美珩(香港綠色建築議會董事). #可持續建築#環保建築#綠色建築#全球暖化#減低碳排放全球.

programme.title: 無界超越殘特奧
programme.sub-title: #4伯樂遇上千里「划」—殘疾賽艇運動員曾星
programme.desc: 今年16歲、印度裔中學生曾星 Kang Sukhman Singh在香港土生土長，出生時因為脊柱問題而不能走路，從少到大都是以輪椅代步，他沒有特別喜好的運動，直至遇上他的划艇「伯樂」陳敏謙教練。. 教練指曾星初試划艇就展出天賦，展現出堅毅的耐力，訓練成績非常出色，經過少於一年的訓練，曾星將會初試啼聲，首次參加今屆殘運會殘疾賽艇PR 1 級別賽事（PR1級別指艇手只可運用肩膀和雙手），年紀輕輕的他是如何接受訓練呢？學校如何支援他？教練對這位年輕殘疾運動員有甚麼期望呢？主持成家宏和温嘉希還會跟曾星一同划艇。. 《拼搏無界限》環節會介紹廣東省殘疾人鐵人三項運動員張健及楊曉婷.

programme.title: 迎戰全國運動會(三) - 運動明星玩過界
programme.sub-title: 第三集：高爾夫球 （嘉賓：劉知名）
programme.desc: 一位球手，一場數小時，完成18洞的比賽。高爾夫球比賽的規則簡單明瞭，卻引人入勝！. 過去賽事習慣赤手空拳的空手道運動員劉知名，今次接受高爾夫球訓練，學習揮桿，嘗試這項富有紳士傳統的運動。由認識「小鳥」、「老鷹」等專業術語，到學習揮桿入洞，每步都充滿挑戰！在最後比賽中，劉知名能否超額完成呢.
